title: Exodia Triumph
summary: Exodia Triumph is an Arcane Enhancement for Zaws that grants a chance to gain additional Combo Count from melee attacks.
extract:
Exodia Triumph is an Arcane Enhancement for Zaws that grants a chance to gain additional Combo Count from melee attacks.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from Hok for  10,000 
per arcane upon reaching the rank of Kin with the Ostrons.

Notes
Melee-based warframe abilities, such as Atlas's Landslide, can generate extra combo through the use of this arcane.
